image_description: The image depicts a chaotic and anatomically impossible scene involving pelicans in water. The foreground features a white pelican with a severely distorted head structure, appearing to have two bills or a fused/duplicated head assembly. Behind it, a dark-plumaged bird (likely a pelican) has wings that are structurally collapsed and melting into the background foliage. The overall composition exhibits severe generative artifacts including limb fusion, texture smearing, and geometric inconsistencies.
